title: RedactSecret Gateway configuration, schema_version 1
description: Machine-readable shape of the static configuration the implementation accepts today. The Rust loader (src/config.rs) is authoritative: it additionally enforces the constraints listed under x-gateway.loader_only_constraints, which JSON Schema cannot express. Keys that are planned but not implemented are NOT accepted here; they are listed under x-gateway.planned. See docs/contracts/config-schema.md.

schema_version.description: Required. Checked before everything else; any other number is unsupported_schema_version.

deployment.description: Deployment authority: listener and upstream provider profile. Nothing under content or resources can change it.

address.description: IP-literal socket address (no hostnames), for example 127.0.0.1:8787. Port 0 asks the OS for a free port. Syntax is checked by the loader.

allow_non_loopback.description: Acknowledges a non-loopback address. Required exactly when the address is not loopback (loader-enforced); not a supported shared or remote deployment (ADR 0009).

upstream.description: Optional. Selects a reviewed provider profile; the profile fixes origin, port, TLS rules and routes. Absent means no route exists.

provider.description: Reviewed profile name, exact case. No URL, host, port, proxy, TLS or route key exists.

content.description: Content policy: core profile and actions. Cannot change listener, origins, TLS, routing, or credential rules.

profile.description: Profile name the pinned core accepts.

pii.description: Optional PII selectors in the core syntax, for example pii:family:global:email. The pinned core's parser decides validity (loader-enforced).

on_warn.description: Disposition of Warn findings. forward is a deliberate operator choice, not redaction.

max_findings.description: Request-wide bound on findings; exceeding it rejects the request.

resources.description: Resource policy: capacities, limits and deadlines.

capacity.description: Global capacity classes. Required; there are no defaults (ADR 0008).

receipt.description: Requests receiving a body at once.

memory_units.description: Aggregate request memory budget in 1 KiB units.

inspection.description: Inspection worker threads and the bound on queued plus running inspection jobs.

limits.description: Optional per-request limits. Every field is optional and keeps its provisional default. All values are provisional pending quiet-host measurement (ADR 0008); see docs/contracts/resource-limits.md.

max_body_bytes.description: Largest accepted request body in bytes.

max_nodes.description: Maximum parsed values plus object keys.

max_string_bytes.description: Maximum decoded bytes of one string or key.

max_messages.description: Maximum Chat Completions messages. Also the planned bound on Responses input items (docs/contracts/responses-request.md); no separate key exists.

admission_wait_ms.description: Longest wait for capacity before an overload rejection; 0 never waits.

admission_queue.description: Most requests waiting for capacity at once; 0 means no queue.

body_deadline_ms.description: Deadline to receive the body, and the absolute deadline for the request head.

upstream_connect_ms.description: Deadline to establish the provider TCP and TLS session.

upstream_header_ms.description: Deadline to the provider response headers. Must not exceed upstream_total_ms (loader-enforced).

upstream_total_ms.description: Deadline from send to the last buffered response byte.

max_response_header_bytes.description: Largest accepted provider response header block.

max_response_body_bytes.description: Largest buffered provider JSON response body.

shutdown_drain_ms.description: Time in-flight requests may finish after a termination signal; 0 cancels immediately.

stream_idle_ms.description: Longest wait for the next provider stream chunk. Must not exceed stream_lifetime_ms (loader-enforced).

stream_write_stall_ms.description: Longest a response write may make no progress.

stream_buffer_bytes.description: Most provider bytes the relay holds at once per stream. capacity.stream times this must not exceed 4 GiB (loader-enforced).

max_connections.description: Most connections served at once; one over the bound is closed at accept.

planned_local_auth.description: NOT part of schema_version 1 as implemented. Frozen design from ADR 0030 / docs/contracts/local-caller-auth.md; enforcement is #63. Deliberately not referenced from deployment.properties, so the loader and this schema both reject deployment.local_auth until #63 moves it there.
x-gateway-planned-constraints: mode disabled forbids token; mode token requires token
token has exactly one of env or file; it is a reference, never a value
allow_non_loopback true additionally requires mode token
token source is resolved at startup (length 32..128, alphabet A-Za-z0-9-._~, file mode and size checks); failures are invalid_config at deployment.local_auth.token

freeze.base_revision_description: main after #82 (PR #97); the #62 freeze commit is the one that adds this file.

openai.note: fixed by the openai provider profile; adds no configuration key

loader_only_constraints: schema_version is checked first; unknown versions and fields are rejected at every depth
duplicate keys, trailing bytes, invalid UTF-8 and files over 64 KiB are rejected before schema evaluation
listener.address must parse as an IP-literal socket address
address loopback must equal NOT allow_non_loopback (invalid_combination at deployment.listener)
content.profile and content.pii are validated by the pinned core, and the whole profile plus PII activation must build
